statement: A new Blackwell B300 server is priced at approximately $500,000 against roughly $150,000-$180,000 for a used 8-GPU H100 server, a gap that keeps prior-generation hardware viable as an alternative supply source.
why: The roughly three-fold price gap between new and prior-generation systems sets how attractive the used market is as a substitute when new accelerators are allocated or delayed.

impact.mechanism: A large new-versus-used price gap sustains secondary-market demand, letting buyers shut out of new allocation add capacity from refurbished systems.

evidence.excerpt: A new B300 server at approximately $500,000
A used H100 server (8-GPU) trades at roughly $150,000-$180,000

confidence.basis: Both figures come from one secondary listing survey; the comparison is the analyst's framing of quoted prices.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 2; sources: Hashrate Index
